title: Safety for Whom? Benchmarking Understanding Beyond Refusal in Egocentric Multimodal Assistants
abstract: arXiv:2610.17728v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Egocentric multimodal assistants see through the user's eyes and guide what the user does next, so their outputs directly shape physical actions, including those that affect bystanders. Yet existing safety evaluations do not distinguish whom a response would harm, and score only whether a model refuses. Pooling all harms into one refusal rate hides two failures: a model may protect one target but not another, and it may refuse without understanding the risk, or understand it and comply anyway. We present STOU, a benchmark of 2,902 egocentric video-audio and video-text queries whose potential harm targets the user (Self), co-present individuals (The Others), or society at large (Others). Our evaluation decouples safety understanding from refusal behavior: beyond refusal, we score whether the model recognizes the user's intent, the presence and target of harm, and its downstream consequences. translated_title: 安全为了谁？在以自我为中心的多模态助手中对拒绝之外的理解能力进行基准测试
translated_abstract: 以自我为中心的多模态助手通过用户的眼睛观察世界，并指导用户接下来的行动，因此它们的输出直接影响物理行为，包括那些会影响旁观者的行为。然而，现有的安全评估并不区分模型的响应会伤害谁，而只评估模型是否拒绝。将所有危害汇总为一个单一的拒绝率会掩盖两类失败：模型可能保护某一类目标却忽视另一类目标；模型也可能在不理解风险的情况下拒绝，或者理解了风险却仍然遵从执行。我们提出了STOU，一个包含2,902个以自我为中心的视频-音频和视频-文本查询的基准测试，其潜在危害对象分别是用户自身、在场的其他人，或整个社会。我们的评估方法将安全理解与拒绝行为解耦：超越单纯的拒绝，我们评估模型是否能识别用户的意图、危害的存在及其针对的目标，以及危害的下游后果。在10个开源和闭源的全模态与……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出STOU基准，首次按危害对象（自身、他人、社会）对以自我为中心的多模态助手进行安全分类评估，并将安全理解能力与拒绝行为解耦，揭示单一拒绝率掩盖的两种安全失败模式。
en_tdlr: STOU is a benchmark of 2,902 egocentric multimodal queries that categorizes safety risks by harm target (Self, The Others, Others) and decouples safety understanding from refusal behavior, exposing failure modes hidden by single refusal rates.
